## Contract and authority

What changes, who may authorize it, and which protected surfaces are affected?

## Evidence

Which positive, negative, replay, failure and recovery tests were run? Include the
source revision and limitations. A test pass is not deployment clearance.

## Source and freeze boundaries

Confirm that no private manuscript was included and no frozen ERBA artifact was
silently amended.

## Dissent, risk and correction

Preserve material objections, unresolved uncertainty, rollback/compensation
limits and the conditions that should reopen this decision.
